date_text: Thu, May 7th • 12:00 PM AEST - Sun, May 10th • 10:00 PM AEST
description: Join us this Thursday as the legends from Dave n Dave’s Brewing roll into town with a bold and playful lineup that’s anything but ordinary. From crisp, hop-driven pales through to a decadent Black Forest pastry stout, the taps are loaded with flavour. And for those after something a little less beery? We’ve got you covered with their Hard Ginger Beer and Hard cherry cola!!! This event has the most Dad & Dave's Brewing limited releases OUTSIDE the brewery - EVER! Tap List: Banoffee Pie-PA (6.5%) Black Forest Gateau Pastry Stout (6.5%) OniBiri - Japanese Rice Lager w/ kombu seaweed (4.9%) Fraise - Strawberry Lager (5%) Myrtille - Blueberry Lager (5%) Dragonfruit Sour (4%) Mandarin Sour (4%) Belgian IPA (5.8%) Citra & Mosaic IPA (7.2%) Pilsner (4.2%) Crusher : Ginger Beer (4.5%) Crusher : Hard Cherry Cola (4.5%)

date_text: Thu, May 14th • 12:00 PM AEST - Sun, May 17th • 10:00 PM AEST
description: The shipments have officially landed from the UK, kicking off two massive weeks of epic British brews at Sweeney’s — and first up, we’re handing the taps over to Cloudwater. Originally, the list was meant to be even bigger but as anyone who imports fresh beer knows, sometimes not every keg survives the container journey. That said, we’ve still managed to get our hands on nine absolute standouts, and we’re pretty confident every single one is going to pour beautifully. We’ve also secured a keg from Deya — and trust us, it tastes every bit as good as you’d hope. So clear the diaries and round up the crew — this is the start of a very big fortnight of incredible UK beer at Sweeney’s. Tap List: - - Piccadilly Pilsner - Fuzzy Pale 4.8% - Several Rituals I Can't Explain Bright Pale - 11th Birthday DCH Pale - 11th Birthday Supercharged IPA - Take It With You IPA - UMAMAMAM IPA - Oinologia Artisinal Ale - Cherry Breeze Sour Deya - Something Good 22

date_text: Thu, May 21st • 12:00 PM AEST - Sun, May 24th • 10:00 PM AEST
description: Part two of the UK shipment is seriously stacked. We’re pouring an incredible lineup from Vault City and Azvex, showcasing two breweries doing some very exciting things in the UK beer scene right now. Vault City are world-renowned for their huge, flavour-packed sours, and if you know, you know. Expect big fruit, bold flavours, and beers that disappear very quickly once the taps start flowing. Azvex, meanwhile, will be making their Sweeney’s rooftop debut — and they’ve arrived with a massive recommendation behind them. We’re genuinely excited to try these beers for the first time alongside everyone else. These kegs won’t last long, and once they’re gone, they’re gone. Get the crew together, get to the rooftop, and settle in for another huge week of incredible UK beer. 🍻 Tap List:- - Azvex Dockers Umbrella Lager - 4.8% - Azvex Barbarian Robin IPA – 6.2% - Azvex Non-Genuine Ink Cartridges DIPA – 8% - Azvex CRUMBLE - Cinnamon Dusted Apple Crumble Ice Cream Sour – 5% - Azvex Plato's Cave Peanut Butter Cookie Stout – 5.8% - Azvex Strategic Reserve 4 Imperial Stout – 11% - Azvex Cacaodemon III Imperial Stout – 12% - Vault City Gold Standard Ferrero Rocher Imp Stout - 15% - Vault City Iron Brew Sour – 5.5% - Vault City Red Berry Waffle Cone Shortcake Triple Scoop – 8.4% - Vault City/One Drop collab - Summer Down Under Smoothie Sour - 6%
